verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents an automatic audit trail covering all work done in the platform, plus one-click case exports and a time-framed Reports History export that includes case comments. Its marketing also says it keeps every decision defensible as cases move between agents and the team. However, the evidence never shows audit entries carrying timestamps, never separates human from automated decisions, and never documents a way to retrieve the audit trail itself as opposed to case data. missing for 10: explicit per-event timestamps in the audit trail, documented capture of automated/agent decisions alongside human ones, a documented audit-log export or API retrieval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions

citations.quote: Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
